adaptationDiffs.reason: PLUMB feature: added sglangProvider (packages/provider/src/vendor-ai/registry/sglang.ts, no upstream counterpart -- see generatedLocalShims) to PROVIDER_REGISTRY/ALL, registering SGLang as a real local OpenAI-compatible provider alongside the existing llama.cpp/vLLM entries. No change to registry lookup/activation logic

PLUMB feature: baseUrl/resourceName/deploymentMap now resolve through resolveProviderConfigValue (PLUMB-saved config > environment variable), matching the PLUMB-config-over-env precedence already established for every other cloud provider, instead of reading AZURE_OPENAI_BASE_URL/AZURE_OPENAI_RESOURCE_NAME/AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT_NAME_MAP directly from process.env. The deployment map is parsed by the unchanged parseAzureDeploymentNameMap using the identical 'model=deployment,...' string shape regardless of source, so an environment-only setup behaves exactly as before. No change to apiKey resolution (already credential-store-backed via options.apiKey/getEnvApiKey) or request-building/streaming logic

PLUMB fix: exported the previously-private DEFAULT_ENDPOINT constant so packages/provider/src/transports/streaming.ts (the transport PlumbContentGenerator actually calls) can send real google-antigravity/google-gemini-cli requests to the real pinned Cloud Code Assist endpoint/path/Bearer-auth instead of the public Gemini API `?key=` shape it was previously using, which leaked the OAuth access token into the URL query string and 404'd. No change to this file's own request-building/streaming logic

PLUMB rebrand: OAuth callback success/error page showed upstream 'oh my pi' branding (title, wordmark, logo) to real PLUMB users completing device/browser OAuth logins (e.g. Antigravity). Replaced with PLUMB title/wordmark/messaging; presentation-only, no change to the __OAUTH_STATE__ contract or page routing

PLUMB fix: the HTML response now serializes a sanitized renderState (ok/error only) instead of the raw resultState, which embedded the OAuth authorization code and state nonce directly into the rendered callback page. No change to the actual code/state values used for token exchange (#callbackResolve/#callbackReject), callback routing, or server lifecycle

PLUMB fix: buildAnthropicClientOptions now throws AIError.MissingApiKeyError for github-copilot when apiKey is empty, instead of silently building an empty `Authorization: Bearer ` header that GitHub rejects as badly formatted

PLUMB fix: resolveOpenAIRequestSetup now throws AIError.MissingApiKeyError for github-copilot when rawApiKey is empty, instead of silently building an empty `Authorization: Bearer ` header that GitHub rejects as badly formatted

PLUMB feature: added sambaNovaModelManagerOptions, nebiusModelManagerOptions, cohereModelManagerOptions, byteplusModelArkModelManagerOptions, volcengineArkModelManagerOptions, and portkeyModelManagerOptions (SambaNova Cloud, Nebius AI Studio, Cohere's OpenAI Compatibility API, BytePlus ModelArk, Volcengine Ark, Portkey AI Gateway — all real OpenAI-compatible providers absent from upstream/the bundled catalog, each verified against official docs before implementation). All reuse the existing createSimpleOpenAICompletionsOptions helper unmodified; the provider id is cast at the call site since getBundledModels(unknownId) safely returns [] and the model list is entirely dynamic-discovery-driven for these six (dynamicModelsAuthoritative: true in descriptors.ts)
PLUMB feature: added CATALOG_PROVIDERS entries for sambanova, nebius, cohere, byteplus-modelark, volcengine-ark, and portkey (see openai-compat.ts adaptationDiffs entry above)

PLUMB fix: consecutive same-role (user/model) content parts are now merged into the last Content entry instead of pushed as a new adjacent-same-role entry, matching CONVERSATION ROLE NORMALIZATION requirements for Google's generateContent wire format (Antigravity/Vertex/Gemini reject or mishandle back-to-back same-role Content turns produced when a multi-part user or tool-result turn spans multiple source messages). No change to per-part transformation logic

PLUMB fix: fetchJson now parses the auth-exchange response body through the shared parseAuthJsonResponse hardening wrapper (./response-parser.ts) instead of raw response.json(), rejecting malformed/oversized bodies safely instead of throwing an unstructured parse error. No change to the device-flow/token-exchange control logic

PLUMB fix: device-authorization, token-poll, and token-refresh responses now parse through the shared parseAuthJsonResponse hardening wrapper (./response-parser.ts) instead of raw response.json(), rejecting malformed/oversized bodies safely. No change to the device-flow/refresh control logic

PLUMB feature: two additive options on fetchOpenAICompatibleModels's config -- (1) apiKeyHeader lets a caller route the discovery credential through a non-Authorization header (used by openai-compat.ts's Portkey descriptor, which must send x-portkey-api-key rather than Bearer); Authorization keeps its existing 'Bearer ' prefix behavior, any other header receives the raw key unprefixed. (2) onFailure is a safe diagnostic hook (kind: 'transport'|'http'|'protocol', plus HTTP status where applicable) that never receives a URL, header, body, or credential -- consumed by registry/model-discovery.ts's OpenAICompatLocalDiscovery to classify local-server SERVER_UNAVAILABLE vs DISCOVERY_AUTH_FAILED vs DISCOVERY_HTTP_ERROR vs DISCOVERY_PROTOCOL_ERROR instead of collapsing every failure into an empty model list. No change to the success path's request shape or the returned model list.
